votes.sql:
WITH company_building_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        c.id AS company_id,
        c.name AS company_name,
        b.id AS building_id,
        b.name AS building_name,
        b.City AS city,
        b.Stories AS stories,
        b.Height AS height
    FROM Companies c
    INNER JOIN Office_locations ol ON c.id = ol.company_id
    INNER JOIN buildings b ON ol.building_id = b.id
),
company_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        company_id,
        company_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT building_id) AS total_buildings,
        SUM(stories) AS total_stories,
        SUM(height) AS total_height
    FROM company_building_stats
    GROUP BY company_id, company_name
)
SELECT 
    cbs.company_name,
    ROUND(AVG(cbs.height * 10 / cbs.stories), 2) AS avg_floor_area_per_employee,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cbs.building_id) AS total_parking_spaces,
    ROUND(AVG(cbs.height * cbs.stories * 100), 0) AS annual_energy_consumption,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cbs.City IN (SELECT City FROM buildings GROUP BY City HAVING AVG(Height) > 200) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT cbs.building_id), 2) AS percentage_office_space_warm_cities
FROM company_building_stats cbs
INNER JOIN company_totals ct ON cbs.company_id = ct.company_id
GROUP BY cbs.company_id, cbs.company_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cbs.building_id) >= 1
ORDER BY percentage_office_space_warm_cities DESC

votes.sql:
WITH banking_companies AS (
    SELECT "id", "Sales_billion"
    FROM "Companies"
    WHERE "Industry" = 'Banking'
),
company_buildings AS (
    SELECT bc."id"            AS company_id,
           bc."Sales_billion",
           b."id"              AS building_id,
           b."Stories",
           ol."move_in_year"
    FROM banking_companies bc
    JOIN "Office_locations" ol ON bc."id" = ol."company_id"
    JOIN "buildings" b        ON ol."building_id" = b."id"
),
recursive_proj AS (
    -- anchor: first known year for each company‑building
    SELECT cb.company_id,
           cb.building_id,
           cb.move_in_year                     AS year,
           cb."Sales_billion" * 0.10          AS opex,
           cb."Sales_billion",
           cb."Stories"
    FROM company_buildings cb
    UNION ALL
    -- recursive step: project next year’s OPEX adding 10% of revenue each year
    SELECT rp.company_id,
           rp.building_id,
           rp.year + 1                         AS year,
           rp.opex + (rp."Sales_billion" * 0.10) AS opex,
           rp."Sales_billion",
           rp."Stories"
    FROM recursive_proj rp
    WHERE rp.year < (
            SELECT MAX(cb2."move_in_year") + 5
            FROM company_buildings cb2
            WHERE cb2.company_id = rp.company_id
        )
),
calc AS (
    SELECT company_id,
           year,
           opex,
           ("Sales_billion" / ("Stories" * 100.0)) AS revenue_per_employee
    FROM recursive_proj
)
SELECT ROUND(
           AVG(revenue_per_employee) OVER (
               PARTITION BY company_id
               ORDER BY year
               ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ), 4
       ) AS rolling_five_year_avg_rev_per_emp
FROM calc
ORDER BY company_id, year;

SELECT 
    c.name,
    c.Sales_billion AS revenue,
    c.Profits_billion AS profits,
    ROUND((c.Profits_billion / NULLIF(c.Sales_billion, 0)) * 100, 2) AS profit_margin_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(c.Sales_billion) OVER (PARTITION BY c.Industry ORDER BY c.Sales_billion ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS rolling_avg_revenue,
    COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_companies
FROM Companies c
WHERE c.Industry = 'Banking'
ORDER BY c.Sales_billion DESC;

)

FROM building_margins
ORDER BY "margin" DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH efficiency AS (
    SELECT
        o.company_id,
        b.id AS building_id,
        b."Height" * 1.0 / NULLIF(b."Stories", 0) AS consumption_per_story,
        o.move_in_year,
        (b."Height" * 1.0 / NULLIF(b."Stories", 0)) / (strftime('%Y','now') - o.move_in_year) AS efficiency_ratio
    FROM Office_locations o
    JOIN buildings b ON b.id = o.build_id
)
SELECT
    c.name,
    e.consumption_per_story,
    e.move_in_year,
    e.efficiency_ratio,
    c."Profits_billion"
FROM efficiency e
JOIN Companies c ON c.id = e.company_id
ORDER BY e.efficiency_ratio ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT c."Industry",
       AVG(b."Height" * 1.0 / b."Stories") AS avg_density
FROM "Companies" c
JOIN "Office_locations" o ON c."id" = o."company_id"
JOIN "buildings" b ON o."building_id" = b."id"
WHERE b."City" = 'Mexico City'
  AND b."Height" > 200
  AND o."move_in_year" > 2015
GROUP BY c."Industry";

votes.sql:
WITH yearly_moves AS (
    SELECT 
        b."LEED" AS leed_level,
        o.move_in_year AS year,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.company_id) AS moves
    FROM "Office_locations" o
    JOIN "buildings" b ON o.building_id = b.id
    GROUP BY b."LEED", o.move_in_year
)
SELECT 
    leed_level,
    year,
    moves,
    CASE 
        WHEN LAG(moves) OVER (PARTITION BY leed_level ORDER BY year) IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND(
            (moves - LAG(moves) OVER (PARTITION BY leed_level ORDER BY year)) * 100.0 /
            LAG(moves) OVER (PARTITION BY leed_level ORDER BY year),
            2
        )
    END AS yoy_growth
FROM yearly_moves
ORDER BY leed_level, year;

WITH yearly_moves AS (
    SELECT 
        b.Status AS certification_level,
        ol.move_in_year AS year,
        COUNT(*) AS num_companies
    FROM "Office_locations" ol
    JOIN "buildings" b ON ol.building_id = b.id
    GROUP BY b.Status, ol.move_in_year
),
with_growth AS (
    SELECT 
        certification_level,
        year,
        num_companies,
        LAG(num_companies) OVER (
            PARTITION BY certification_level ORDER BY year
        ) AS prev_companies,
        CASE 
            WHEN LAG(num_companies) OVER (
                PARTITION BY certification_level ORDER BY year
            ) > 0 THEN
                ROUND(
                    (num_companies * 100.0 / LAG(num_companies) OVER (
                        PARTITION BY certification_level ORDER BY year
                    )) - 100,
                    2
                )
            ELSE NULL
        END AS growth_rate_percent
    FROM yearly_moves
)
SELECT 
    certification_level,
    year,
    num_companies,
    growth_rate_percent
FROM with_growth
WHERE prev_companies IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY certification_level, year;
